# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster can see the aura of any person within range of this spell. This spell
will tell the caster the purpose of any aura type spells active on the target,
as well as the general skills of the target, and his general demeanor.
@@ 2
Caster’s aura gives off light in a 20-foot radius.
@@ 3
Creates a bright aura around the target, making him appear more powerful and
subtracting 5 from all attacks against the target.
@@ 4
All within the area of effect, including the caster, receive a special bonus
of +20 to any fear or influence RRs.
@@ 5
All within the area of effect, including the caster, are immune to any life
draining effects of Undead.
@@ 6
As Aura I, except the modifier is -10.
@@ 7
The caster may extend the radius of his aura, bestowing the effects of any
Aura I spell that the caster has going on those within the area of effect.
@@ 8
All within the area of effect, including the caster, receive a special bonus
of +5 bonus to their melee and missile OBs for the duration.
@@ 9
A bright, shimmering aura surrounds the caster. All creatures ''of darkness''
who are in the area of effect must make a RR each round or receive an ''A''
Holy Spell critical.
@@ 10
As Aura I, except the modifier is -15.
@@ 11
A holy blazing light surrounds the caster. All within the area of effect that
are not allied with the caster must make an RR each round or suffer an ''A''
Holy Spell critical.
@@ 12
As Aura Share I, except for area of effect, and will work with Aura II.
@@ 13
As Aura Light, except for area of effect, and the created light will nullify
all magically created darkness for the duration.
@@ 14
All within the area of effect, including the caster, receive +15 bonuses to
their RR rolls.
@@ 15
As Holy Aura I, except it delivers a ''B'' critical.
@@ 16
As Aura I, except the modifier is -20.
@@ 17
All spells or spell effects entering the radius of this spell must make an RR.
For RR purposes, each spell uses a level equal to its caster's level. If the
incoming spell passes the RR, it may proceed normally; otherwise the incoming
spell is canceled while in the area of effect.
@@ 18
As Aura Blaze I, except it delivers a ''B'' critical.
@@ 19
As Aura Share II, except for area of effect, and will work with Divine Aura.
@@ 20
As Holy Aura I, except it delivers a ''C'' critical.
@@ 25
As Aura I, except the modifier is -25.
@@ 30
As Holy Aura I, except it delivers a ''D'' critical, and as Aura Blaze I,
except it delivers a ''C'' critical.
@@ 50
As Aura I, except that caster seems as a deity, and the modifier is -45.
